name: ai-sdr-core
description: Vendor-neutral AI SDR expertise: the SDR business-operation contract, outbound strategy and playbooks, and the guardrails that keep automated outreach safe. Provider-independent — no Reply.io knowledge required.

interface.shortDescription: Run real outbound with guardrails, not guesswork

Vendor-neutral: it needs no Reply.io account and no provider at all.
